correctness.rationale: For a product of r fields, nonzero proper ideals correspond to nonempty proper subsets S of [r], and adjacency is exactly nonempty intersection. The incidence Gram matrix A=B^T B has off-diagonal entry |S∩T|, hence exactly the graph pattern, and rank r because B contains every standard basis column. Thus maximum nullity is at least n-r. The explicit white family is forced by the singleton sequence and then the final two-set, proving zero forcing at most n-r. The standard inequality M≤Z forces equality, and hence minimum rank r.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact inverse-eigenvalue invariant for a natural family arising from reduced Artinian rings: real minimum rank equals the number of field factors. It simultaneously determines zero forcing and maximum nullity and gives an explicit minimum forcing construction, recovering algebraic factor count from a graph parameter.
